content_metadata.description: A comprehensive analysis of the long-term consequences of COVID-19, emphasizing the need to consider morbidity and quality of life for recovered patients, alongside ongoing data collection efforts.

qAndA.question: Besides shortness of breath, what is the most common lingering effect the doctor observes in patients who were hospitalized but did not require the ICU?

qAndA.answer: Sinus tachycardia (an exaggerated heart rate response but not a true arrhythmia)
qAndA.question: What specific heart rhythm abnormality does the doctor mention seeing in patients who experience rapid heartbeats after COVID-19 recovery?
What is the name of the app that allows COVID-19 recovered patients to track and report their symptoms?

qAndA.answer: Cognitive/brain effects and muscle weakness/neuromuscular effects
qAndA.question: What two broad categories of post-ICU syndrome (PICS) does the doctor discuss?

qAndA.answer: Microthrombi (small blood clots) in brain blood vessels.
qAndA.question: Besides low oxygen levels, what other potential mechanism for brain injury does the doctor discuss in relation to COVID-19?

He analyzes the long-term effects seen in hospitalized patients, differentiating between ICU and non-ICU cases.
